scientific_question: Does one permutation-invariant global camera-set state identify the full 96-key Riesz-action target more reliably than the v144 direction-local neighborhoods?
reason_for_new_gate: v144 independently showed that the existing 155-dimensional per-direction metric reaches only 1/20 cross-trajectory and 8/20 same-trajectory sentinels. v145 changes the physical representation rather than enlarging that local model: all 96 structural directions share one sample-level camera-set neighborhood, and the richer signature explicitly couples deployment-visible detector state to reported pose.

immutable_roster.sentinel_indices: reuse the frozen v143 one-per-trajectory-by-camera-count roster
immutable_roster.teacher_target: validated v143 geometry-local block Riesz action
immutable_roster.direction_selector: reuse the target-blind v144 SHA256 structural-key selector

deployment_visible_inputs.camera_feature_source: the sealed v142.3 45-dimensional per-camera feature: observation, exact-K1 residual and exact-K1 dual low-frequency detector summaries plus reported pose
deployment_visible_inputs.active_camera_mask_source: sealed camera count in the v142.3 feature barrier

moments_control.definition: four-way active-camera-count one-hot, active-camera mean of all 45 features, and active-camera population standard deviation of all 45 features

observable_pose_coupled_primary.definition: the 94 moment features followed by the flattened 27x18 active-camera cross-covariance between centered detector-observable features and centered reported-pose features
observable_pose_coupled_primary.physical_role: retain which deployment-visible detector state co-varies with which reported camera geometry while remaining invariant to camera order

global_signatures.outer_fit_whitening: per fold and per signature, mean and population standard deviation from all 2960 outer-fit samples
global_signatures.distance: root mean squared Euclidean distance over active whitened dimensions

fixed_predictors.same_trajectory_diagnostic_candidates: all other 739 samples from the opened query trajectory
fixed_predictors.prediction_target: one 96-key target vector per candidate sample using the frozen structural-key selector
fixed_predictors.shared_neighbor_rule: one neighbor roster predicts all 96 keys for a query
fixed_predictors.cheap_control: outer-fit mean 96-key target conditioned only on active camera count

barriers.reason_process_level_never_read_not_clai: Every sample is an outer-fold query and also an eligible fit candidate for other trajectory folds; the same-trajectory post-open diagnostic reads other labels from the query trajectory. Isolation is therefore asserted and audited per cross fold, not as a false process-wide claim.

decision_rule.count_mean_control_passes: Prefer the cheaper camera-count mean and close learned/nonlinear global-state claims.
decision_rule.cross_moments_passes_and_control_fails: Record global-moment representation headroom; only a separately frozen all-direction CPU predictor may follow.
decision_rule.cross_coupled_passes_while_cheaper_metho: Record observable-pose coupling headroom; only a separately frozen all-direction CPU predictor may follow.
decision_rule.same_trajectory_moments_or_coupled_passe: Record within-trajectory identifiability without cross-trajectory transfer; do not train a larger model.
decision_rule.both_same_trajectory_signatures_fail: Close the frozen global moment and observable-pose-coupled local metrics; do not rescue them with GPU or a larger model.
decision_rule.execution_or_independent_recomputation_f: Inconclusive; preserve evidence and do not interpret partial arrays.
